bot_answer: **Fee‑payment deadlines at the University of Embu**  1. **Standard (full‑payment) requirement** – Students must pay all fees in full **upon reporting** (i.e., before the registration deadline).  2. **Phased‑fee‑payment option** (if approved) – The payment plan is:    - **First instalment:** at least **50 % of the total semester fees** **before the registration deadline**. Approval of the phased option is granted only after this payment.    - **Second instalment:** enough to bring the total paid to **at least 75 %** of the semester fees **by the end of the 7th week of the semester** (mid‑semester).    - **Final instalment:** the **remaining balance** **by the end of the 11th week of the semester** (some documents also note the balance must be cleared **by the end of the 13th week** for registration and eligibility to sit for examinations).  3. **Examination requirement** – All fees (including any outstanding balance, administrative fees and penalties) must be cleared **before the start of examinations**; otherwise a student will not be issued an exam card and cannot sit for exams.  4. **Late‑payment penalty** – If a student does not pay at least 50 % of the semester fee by the registration deadline, a **one‑off late‑payment penalty of KES 3,000** is added to the regular 2.5 % administrative fee on the outstanding balance.
